intro:
**Short answer: the best robot vacuum deal for most homes is the Roborock Qrevo S Pro at £299.99 at Amazon (was £549.99). It vacuums, mops, empties itself and washes its own mop. We picked 11 robot vacuums from about £120 to £900, with prices reported or checked on 25 and 26 November 2026. Each card links to the retailer, and non-Amazon picks also get a link to compare today's Amazon price.

body:
## Quick picks

- **Best overall: Roborock Qrevo S Pro at £299.99.** It vacuums and mops, empties its own bin, and washes and dries its mops, which is what saves you real time.
- **Best cheap: Dreame L40 Ultra at £269.** A full self-cleaning dock for less than some basic robots. If you only want a robot to keep hard floors tidy, the Roomba 115 Combo is £119.
- **Best splurge: Roborock Saros 20 at £799.** A record low on one of the best robots you can buy.

Prices come from TechRadar's Amazon UK live coverage, Talk Android and the retailers' own pages on 25 and 26 November 2026, during Amazon's Black Friday Week. Many deals should last until Cyber Monday (30 November); iRobot's sale ends 1 December at 6am. For everything else on sale today, see our [Black Friday 2026 live deals](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/) and [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).

## How to choose a robot vacuum

**1. Decide how much you want the dock to do.** This matters more than suction figures. A basic robot (Roomba 115 Combo) needs its small bin emptied after every run or two. A self-emptying dock (Shark Matrix Plus) holds weeks of dust. An all-in-one dock (Dreame L40 Ultra, Qrevo S Pro, Eufy X10 Pro Omni and up) also refills the mop water and washes and dries the pads, so you only top up a clean-water tank and empty a dirty one.

**2. Get LiDAR mapping.** Every pick here maps your home with a laser or camera system, so you can set no-go zones, clean one room at a time and send it round after dinner. Cheap robots without mapping bounce around randomly and miss bits.

**3. Mops that lift or swing out are worth having.** If you have rugs as well as hard floors, look for mop pads that lift when the robot reaches carpet (all the docked models above do). Models with an extending mop or arm (Dreame X60) clean closer to skirting boards.

**4. Check the height.** Measure under your sofa and beds. Robots with a pop-up LiDAR turret, or slim ones like the Ecovacs T50, get under more furniture.

**5. Count the running costs.** Self-emptying docks use dust bags (around £10–£15 for a few). The Ecovacs X11 OmniCyclone is bagless, which saves on that. Mop pads and side brushes need replacing every few months on all of them.

## What's a good price?

Robot vacuums have some of the most inflated 'was' prices around, so judge each one on what it costs now:

- **Under £150:** a basic mapping robot that vacuums and mops, without a dock.
- **£230–£270:** self-emptying, or a full all-in-one dock if you catch a deal like the Dreame L40 Ultra.
- **£300:** the sweet spot. The Qrevo S Pro, Eufy X10 Pro Omni and Ecovacs T50 Pro Omni all have full docks at around this price.
- **£800–£900:** flagships like the Saros 20, Dreame X60 and Eufy Omni S2. These were £1,200 to £1,600 at launch.

Dyson's Spot+Scrub AI is £849 direct, but Which?'s price data shows it has been as low as £649 in the last six months, so we've left it out. The same goes for Samsung's Jet Bot Combo (£600 at John Lewis today, £549 at its recent low).

## When do robot vacuum prices drop?

The lowest prices of the year usually land in Amazon's Prime Day (July), Prime Big Deal Days (October) and Black Friday Week. Most of the deals above are at or near their lows now. Older models also get cleared out in January as new ones arrive, but stock of the best ones runs low first.

Buying at Amazon? A [Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) gets you faster delivery and Prime-only deals through Cyber Monday. Our guide to [timing the Prime trial](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how it works. Prefer a cordless stick vacuum for the stairs too? Read [Shark vs Dyson cordless](/guides/shark-vs-dyson-cordless/).

## Robot vacuum FAQs

### Is a robot vacuum worth it in the UK?

Yes, if you have mostly hard floors or short carpet and want floors kept tidy between proper cleans. It won't replace a cordless vacuum for stairs, sofas or the car, but it cuts how often you need one.

### What is the best robot vacuum for the money?

Right now, the Roborock Qrevo S Pro at £299.99 at Amazon. You get a full self-emptying, mop-washing dock and good mapping for well under half its launch price.

### Do robot vacuums work on carpet?

They work well on short and medium-pile carpet. Deep-pile rugs, tassels and loose cables cause trouble, so tidy cables away and set rugs with fringes as no-go zones in the app.

### Are robot vacuums cheaper on Black Friday?

Usually, yes. Black Friday and Prime Day are when the biggest drops happen, and several models here (Roborock Saros 20, Dreame X60 Pro Ultra) are at record lows this week.

### Can a robot vacuum mop properly?

The ones with spinning or vibrating pads and a washing dock do a good job on everyday dirt and footprints. They won't scrub dried-on stains, so expect a light daily mop rather than a deep clean.
